bash: {"command": "bash -lc 'cat > /tmp/collect_audit.sh << "EOF"
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# Инициализация JSON
JSON_FILE="/tmp/system_audit_report.json"
: > "$JSON_FILE"
jq -n . > "$JSON_FILE"

# Вспомогательная функция для добавления в JSON
add_json() {
  local key="$1"
  local value="$2"
  jq --arg k "$key" --arg v "$value" '.[$k] = $v' "$JSON_FILE" > "${JSON_FILE}.tmp" && mv "${JSON_FILE}.tmp" "$JSON_FILE"
}

# ОС и ядро
if command -v lsb_release >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  add_json "os_lsb" "$(lsb_release -ds 2>/dev/null || echo "N/A")"
else
  add_json "os_lsb" "N/A"
fi
if [[ -f /etc/os-release ]]; then
  add_json "os_release" "$(grep -E '^PRETTY_NAME=' /etc/os-release | cut -d= -f2- | tr -d '"')"
else
  add_json "os_release" "N/A"
fi
add_json "kernel" "$(uname -r)"
add_json "hostname" "$(uname -n)"

# Пользователи и группы
add_json "current_user" "$(whoami)"
add_json "uid_gid" "$(id)"
add_json "all_users" "$(awk -F: '$3>=1000{print $1}' /etc/passwd | paste -sd, -)"
add_json "all_groups" "$(awk -F: '$3>=1000{print $1}' /etc/group | paste -sd, -)"

# SUID/SGID
mapfile -t suid < <(find / -type f -perm -4000 2>/dev/null | sort || true)
mapfile -t sgid < <(find / -type f -perm -2000 2>/dev/null | sort || true)
add_json "suid_count" "${#suid[@]}"
add_json "sgid_count" "${#sgid[@]}"
# Сохраняем первые 20 примеров
printf "%s\n" "${suid[@]:0:20}" > /tmp/suid_examples.txt
printf "%s\n" "${sgid[@]:0:20}" > /tmp/sgid_examples.txt
add_json "suid_examples" "$(paste -sd, - < /tmp/suid_examples.txt || true)"
add_json "sgid_examples" "$(paste -sd, - < /tmp/sgid_examples.txt || true)"

# Процессы
add_json "top_processes" "$(ps -eo pid,ppid,user,comm,%mem,%cpu --sort=-%mem | head -n 15 | tail -n +2)"

# Службы (systemd)
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  add_json "active_services" "$(systemctl list-units --type=service --state=running --no-legend --no-pager 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | paste -sd, - || true)"
  add_json "failed_services" "$(systemctl list-units --type=service --state=failed --no-legend --no-pager 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | paste -sd, - || true)"
else
  add_json "active_services" "N/A"
  add_json "failed_services" "N/A"
fi

# Сеть: соединения и порты
if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  add_json "listening_ports" "$(ss -tulpen 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2 | awk '{print $1,$5,$6}' | sort -u | paste -sd, - || true)"
else
  add_json "listening_ports" "N/A"
fi
if command -v netstat >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  add_json "network_connections" "$(netstat -tupan 2>/dev/null | tail -n +3 | head -n 50 | awk '{print $1,$4,$5,$6,$7}' | paste -sd, - || true)"
else
  add_json "network_connections" "N/A"
fi

# Диски и ФС
add_json "df_h" "$(df -h | tail -n +2 | paste -sd, - || true)"
add_json "mounts" "$(mount | paste -sd, - || true)"
add_json "lsblk" "$(lsblk -d -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,MOUNTPOINT 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2 | paste -sd, - || true)"

# Загрузка CPU/память
add_json "loadavg" "$(cat /proc/loadavg || true)"
add_json "meminfo" "$(grep -E 'MemTotal|MemAvailable|MemFree|Buffers|Cached' /proc/meminfo | paste -sd, - || true)"

# Cron/таймеры
if command -v crontab >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  add_json "user_crontab" "$(crontab -l 2>/dev/null || echo 'no crontab')"
else
  add_json "user_crontab" "N/A"
fi
if [[ -d /etc/cron.d ]]; then
  add_json "cron_d_entries" "$(ls -1 /etc/cron.d 2>/dev/null | paste -sd, - || true)"
else
  add_json "cron_d_entries" "N/A"
fi
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  add_json "timers" "$(systemctl list-timers --all --no-legend --no-pager 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | paste -sd, - || true)"
else
  add_json "timers" "N/A"
fi
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/collect_audit.sh"]"}
